# Masked tails must not read past the slice end: every tail length is
# summed at the end of a mapped page backed by a guard page, so an
# over-read faults and a wrong lane value mismatches the oracle.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'no-guard-padding probe needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd

cd m
logos run .
! stdout 'MISMATCH'
stdout '^int8 ok 0$'
stdout '^uint8 ok 0$'
stdout '^int16 ok 0$'
stdout '^uint16 ok 0$'
stdout '^int32 ok 0$'
stdout '^uint32 ok 0$'
stdout '^int64 ok 0$'
stdout '^uint64 ok 0$'
stdout '^float32 ok 0$'
stdout '^float64 ok 0$'

cd ../a
logos run .
! stdout 'MISMATCH'
stdout '^pad32 0$'
stdout '^pad64 0$'

cd ../o
logos run .
stdout '^ordinary allocation ok$'

-- o/go.mod --
module example.com/ordinarynopadding

go 1.27

-- o/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/debug"
)

var bytes []byte
var floats32 []float32
var floats64 []float64

func main() {
	debug.SetGCPercent(-1)
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	for size := 32768; size <= 49152; size += 8192 {
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
		bytes = make([]byte, size)
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
		if got := after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc; got != uint64(size) {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("control %d %d", size, got))
		}
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
		floats32 = make([]float32, size/4)
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
		if got := after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc; got != uint64(size) {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("ordinary32 %d %d", size, got))
		}
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
		floats64 = make([]float64, size/8)
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
		if got := after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc; got != uint64(size) {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("ordinary64 %d %d", size, got))
		}
		bytes[size-1] = 7
		floats32[size/4-1] = 11
		floats64[size/8-1] = 13
		if len(bytes) != size || cap(bytes) != size || bytes[size-1] != 7 || len(floats32) != size/4 || cap(floats32) != size/4 || floats32[size/4-1] != 11 || len(floats64) != size/8 || cap(floats64) != size/8 || floats64[size/8-1] != 13 {
			panic("ordinary values")
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("ordinary allocation ok")
}

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/nopadalloc

go 1.27

-- a/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"runtime/debug"
)

func pad32(s []float32) int {
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	best := int64(1 << 62)
	for r := 0; r < 8; r++ {
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
		s.sum()
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
		d := int64(after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc)
		if d < best {
			best = d
		}
	}
	return int(best - int64(len(s))*4)
}

func pad64(s []float64) int {
	var before, after runtime.MemStats
	best := int64(1 << 62)
	for r := 0; r < 8; r++ {
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&before)
		s.sum()
		runtime.ReadMemStats(&after)
		d := int64(after.TotalAlloc - before.TotalAlloc)
		if d < best {
			best = d
		}
	}
	return int(best - int64(len(s))*8)
}

func main() {
	debug.SetGCPercent(-1)
	bad32 := 0
	bad64 := 0
	for n := 1; n <= 129; n++ {
		s32 := make([]float32, n)
		for i := range s32 {
			s32[i] = float32(i)*0.5 + 1
		}
		if p := pad32(s32); p > 0 {
			bad32++
			fmt.Println("MISMATCH pad32", n, p)
		}
		s64 := make([]float64, n)
		for i := range s64 {
			s64[i] = float64(i)*0.5 + 1
		}
		if p := pad64(s64); p > 0 {
			bad64++
			fmt.Println("MISMATCH pad64", n, p)
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("pad32", bad32)
	fmt.Println("pad64", bad64)
}
-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/noguardpadding

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

const maxLen = 2*64 + 1

type intKind interface {
	~int8 | ~uint8 | ~int16 | ~uint16 | ~int32 | ~uint32 | ~int64 | ~uint64
}

type floatKind interface {
	~float32 | ~float64
}

func pageEnd[T any](n int) ([]T, func()) {
	page := syscall.Getpagesize()
	mem, err := syscall.Mmap(-1, 0, 2*page, syscall.PROT_READ|syscall.PROT_WRITE, syscall.MAP_ANON|syscall.MAP_PRIVATE)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if err := syscall.Mprotect(mem[page:], syscall.PROT_NONE); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	var zero T
	size := int(unsafe.Sizeof(zero))
	s := unsafe.Slice((*T)(unsafe.Pointer(&mem[page-n*size])), n)
	return s, func() {
		if err := syscall.Munmap(mem); err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	}
}

func oracleInt[T intKind](s []T) T {
	var t T
	for _, v := range s {
		t += v
	}
	return t
}

func oracleFloat[T floatKind](s []T) T {
	switch len(s) {
	case 0:
		return 0
	case 1:
		return s[0]
	}
	m := len(s) / 2
	return oracleFloat(s[:m]) + oracleFloat(s[m:])
}

func mixFloat(i int) float64 {
	return math.Ldexp(float64((i*2654435761>>3)%2001-1000), (i*7)%13-6)
}

func checkInt[T intKind](name string, sum func([]T) T) {
	bad := 0
	for n := 1; n <= maxLen; n++ {
		s, release := pageEnd[T](n)
		for i := range s {
			s[i] = T(i*37 + 11)
		}
		if got, want := sum(s), oracleInt(s); got != want {
			bad++
			fmt.Println("MISMATCH", name, n, got, want)
		}
		release()
	}
	fmt.Println(name, "ok", bad)
}

func checkFloat32(name string, sum func([]float32) float32) {
	bad := 0
	for n := 1; n <= maxLen; n++ {
		s, release := pageEnd[float32](n)
		for i := range s {
			s[i] = float32(mixFloat(i))
		}
		if got, want := sum(s), oracleFloat(s); math.Float32bits(got) != math.Float32bits(want) {
			bad++
			fmt.Println("MISMATCH", name, n, got, want)
		}
		release()
	}
	fmt.Println(name, "ok", bad)
}

func checkFloat64(name string, sum func([]float64) float64) {
	bad := 0
	for n := 1; n <= maxLen; n++ {
		s, release := pageEnd[float64](n)
		for i := range s {
			s[i] = mixFloat(i)
		}
		if got, want := sum(s), oracleFloat(s); math.Float64bits(got) != math.Float64bits(want) {
			bad++
			fmt.Println("MISMATCH", name, n, got, want)
		}
		release()
	}
	fmt.Println(name, "ok", bad)
}

func main() {
	checkInt("int8", func(s []int8) int8 { return s.sum() })
	checkInt("uint8", func(s []uint8) uint8 { return s.sum() })
	checkInt("int16", func(s []int16) int16 { return s.sum() })
	checkInt("uint16", func(s []uint16) uint16 { return s.sum() })
	checkInt("int32", func(s []int32) int32 { return s.sum() })
	checkInt("uint32", func(s []uint32) uint32 { return s.sum() })
	checkInt("int64", func(s []int64) int64 { return s.sum() })
	checkInt("uint64", func(s []uint64) uint64 { return s.sum() })
	checkFloat32("float32", func(s []float32) float32 { return s.sum() })
	checkFloat64("float64", func(s []float64) float64 { return s.sum() })
}
